result.description: Quest Events Pty Limited   Program / Project Administrator – Conferences    Location:  Sydney (Northern Beaches), NSW   Salary:  $75,000 - $85,000 + Superannuation (Base salary commensurate with experience)   Job Type:  Full-time   About Quest   At Quest, we deliver high-quality B2B conferences and exhibitions across a range of industries undergoing significant change, including energy transition and emerging technology. We are seeking an organized and driven  Program / Project Administrator  to support the planning, administrative execution, and delivery of multiple conference programs and related projects across the business.   About the Role   Working closely with Project Managers and senior stakeholders, you will be responsible for coordinating the administrative and end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of conference projects. You will ensure project timelines, resource allocation, and administrative deliverables are managed effectively.   Key responsibilities include:   Coordinating project timelines, master schedules, and deliverables across 6–7 conferences annually.  Assisting project managers in monitoring project milestones and tracking progress against agreed project management plans.  Maintaining comprehensive project documentation, risk registers, records, and reporting systems.  Liaising with internal teams, speakers, sponsors, and external suppliers to ensure smooth project delivery and contract compliance.  Supporting the development and implementation of conference programs in line with broader organizational objectives.  Assisting with project budgeting processes, tracking project-related costs, and reporting on variances.  Preparing detailed project reports, briefs, and post-event administrative summaries for internal and external stakeholders.  Supporting the continuous improvement of project processes, administrative systems, and delivery standards.   About You (Skills & Experience Required)   To be successful in this role, you must meet the following criteria:   Qualifications:  A relevant tertiary qualification (Advanced Diploma/Associate Degree or higher) in Business, Project Management, or a related discipline. Alternatively, a minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience as a project/program coordinator or administrator may be considered.  Minimum of 1–2 years of demonstrated experience in project coordination, program administration, or complex event delivery environments.  Proven organizational and time management skills, with a track record of supporting multiple concurrent projects under tight deadlines.  Demonstrated experience with structured project processes, tracking milestones, and maintaining documentation control.  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to confidently liaise with high-level corporate stakeholders.  High attention to detail, particularly regarding budget tracking and reporting data.   What We Offer   Exposure to a wide range of fast-growing industries and high-level corporate stakeholders.  Opportunity to build robust, structured experience across multiple concurrent project portfolios.  Supportive team environment with clear processes, systems, and modern project management tools.  Career development pathways within corporate project and program management.  Fantastic beachside office location in Sydney's Northern Beaches.  If you have the administrative rigor and project coordination skills to thrive in a fast-paced environment, please submit your application, including your CV and cover letter.  About Company     Quest Events is a fast-growing business information and networking event provider – producing timely and relevant conferences, exhibitions and training seminars for industry and government participants alike.    Through high-level networking and knowledge provision, our unique events are designed to inform and inspire you – helping you grow your business and progress your career.    Our team has extensive experience developing and staging live, face-to-face, content led events in a wide range of sectors, both domestically and abroad.    The in-depth research that goes into the production of every Quest event means you can be assured of the highest level of quality and can expect value that is second to none.    Our mission, put simply, is to become and remain the leading producer of business events of the highest quality, providing you with unrivalled opportunities to Meet. Learn. Grow. It's what we’re all about.
